## 中文原文
晚上你准备给宝宝做辅食，先把南瓜去皮切块，上锅蒸熟。蒸好之后倒进辅食机打成细腻的泥。尝了一点点，甜度刚刚好。你等它放凉一点，再装到辅食碗里喂给宝宝。

## My translation
I was going to make complementary food for my baby this evening.
I firstly peeled a pumpkin, then chopped it into slices, and put them in a steamer.
After being steamed, I poured them into a complementary food machine for softer status.
I tasted a bit and the sweetness was just good.
I waited for it to cool down, then got them into the bowl to feed the baby.

## Revised version
I was going to make baby food for my baby this evening.
First, I peeled the pumpkin, cut it into chunks and put them in the steamer.
Once it was steamed, I transfered it to the food processor to blend it into a smooth puree.
I tried a little bit, and it was just sweet enough.
I let it cool slightly, then scooped it into a bowl to feed my baby.

## Key phrases
- make baby food
- peel the pumpkin，南瓜去皮
- cut it into chunks，切块
- food processor，辅食机
- blend it into a smooth puree，打成细腻的辅食泥
- scoop it into a bowl，舀到碗里
